export function projectType(root) {

    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}

## Objective
- Build a Yu-Gi-Oh-style, text-only online room-list card game “DUEL 24” in the empty `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround` repo, per the user’s Japanese request.
- Key requested elements: mandatory personal room created and auto-joined on startup, online room list, duel, 24 zones, cards always animate, no card images, Yu-Gi-Oh-style, LP reduced to 0 as win condition, and solo mode.

## Requirements
- 起動時に必ず自分のルームを立てる (always create own room at startup).
- そのルームに必ず参加している状態 (always joined to it).
- 相手のライフポイントを0にする勝利条件 (LP 0 = victory).
- オンラインルームリスト形式 (online room list).
- 24ゾーン (24 zones total).
- 必ずカードが動く (guaranteed card motion/animation).
- カード画像なし (no card images; text/CSS cards only).
- 遊戯王風 (Yu-Gi-Oh-style gameplay).
- ソロモードも (solo mode too).

## Decisions
- Interpreted LP requirement as “reduce opponent’s LP to 0 to win,” with 8000 starting LP.
- Field layout: 5 monster + 5 spell/trap + 1 field zone per player (11 × 2) + 2 shared Extra Monster Zones (EMZ) = 24 zones.
- Implemented fully client-side static site; “online” rooms are simulated locally with live-updating bots/rooms and localStorage persistence.
- No images or external assets; card art uses text glyphs and CSS gradients.
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/ES modules; no framework/build step.
- Split UI into modules to keep file sizes manageable.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built complete static app structure: `index.html`, `css/app.css`, JS modules.
- Implemented card database, 3 decks of exactly 40 main + 3 EX each (verified).
- Implemented duel engine: summons, tribute summons, sets, spells, traps, EX summons, attacks, positions, LP, deck-out, win detection, 24-zone state, logs.
- Implemented CPU AI and ran 300 AI-vs-AI simulations: 0 errors, 0 stuck, wins 141/159, avg 8.2 turns.
- Implemented lobby, auto-room panel, live room list, room detail, deck picker, profile editing, records.
- Implemented duel board rendering, action tray, card detail/pile/log modals, result modal, rematch, leave confirmation.
- Implemented animation system: card ghosts, attack lunges, destroy effects, rings, sparks, damage floats, LP pulses, card idle bob/sheen, draw/summon/set/flip animations, synthesized WebAudio SFX.
- Added responsive/mobile CSS and 24-zone labels `Z01`–`Z24`.
- Fixed several issues: missing `#youTag`, missing core/duel imports, room persistence/joined-room row, object room lookup, AI winner check, `canExtraSummon`, etc.

### Active
- Browser verification with `playwright-cli` has not yet been performed.
- Visual/layout tuning and runtime bug fixing likely needed after first browser load.
- No screenshots captured yet.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Serve the app (e.g. `PORT=3000 node /home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs` or `./start.sh` with `RUNTIME_DIR` set) and open `http://localhost:3000`.
2. Use `playwright-cli` to inspect lobby, auto-room toast, room list, room detail, solo duel, and a full duel turn; check console/page errors.
3. Verify mobile 390×844 layout, 24 zone rendering, hand/board interactions, direct attack, EX summon, traps, result modal, rematch.
4. Fix any runtime/layout issues and add missing CSS if needed.
5. Capture desktop/mobile screenshots and inspect them.
6. Optionally update `README.md` with game instructions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: app shell, lobby/room/duel screens, modal/toast/fx containers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/app.css`: full visual system, board/cards, animations, responsive rules.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/cards.js`: card definitions, attributes, 3 deck recipes, deck builders.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/engine.js`: duel rules/state engine and event emission.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ai.js`: CPU action heuristics.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/rooms.js`: simulated online room list, mandatory auto-room, profile persistence.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/fx.js`: capture/ghost animations, particles, synth SFX, `playEvents`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui-core.js`: shared state (`app`), modal/toast/screen helpers, `cardHTML`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/duel-render.js`: duel board rendering, tray, `startDuel`, `renderDuel`, turn banner.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui-duel.js`: duel input, engine actions, AI loop, modals, results, leave.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui-lobby.js`: lobby/profile/room list/room detail logic.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: boot sequence (`initParticles`, `initRooms`, `initCore`, `initLobby`, `initDuel`).
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: static server used by `start.sh` (serves `index.html` on `PORT`/3000).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: launches runtime static server.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: currently default OMGithub readme, likely needs replacing.

## Important Context
- Repo was initially empty except process/README scaffolding; all game files are newly created and currently uncommitted.
- The runtime only supports static deployment (`index.html` or Vite); no backend/WebSocket, hence simulated local online rooms.
- Deck size validation command passed:
  `flame 40 3`, `abyss 40 3`, `gear 40 3`.
- AI simulation command passed: 300 games, `{wins:{you:141,opp:159}, errors:0, stuck:0, avgTurns:8.216, maxTurns:19, minTurns:4}`.
- All JS files pass `node --check`.
- Known code detail: `duel-render.js` imports unused `sleep`; harmless.
- `app.showTurnBanner` is registered in `initDuel`; `startDuel` calls `app.runAiTurn` after 1050 ms if opponent goes first.
- Room list keeps joined other rooms in the pool with `joined: true`; tick skips joined rooms.

# DUEL 24 — LP0 ONLINE ROOM LIST

遊戯王風のルールを、カード画像なしのテキストカードだけで楽しむブラウザ対戦ゲームです。
起動すると自分のルームが自動で作成され、自動参加した状態から始まります。

- 相手の **LP を 0** にすれば勝利
- フィールドは **24 ゾーン**
  - モンスター 5 + 魔法・罠 5 + フィールド 1（各プレイヤー）
  - 共有 EX ゾーン 2
- カード画像は **0 枚**。すべて CSS と文字で描画
- カードは常時アニメーション（浮遊・光沢・召喚・攻撃・破壊演出）
- オンラインルームリストから対戦、または CPU とのソロ対戦
- デスクトップ / スマートフォン対応

## 起動方法

静的サイトです。任意の静的サーバーでリポジトリ直下を配信してください。

```bash
# このリポジトリに含まれる起動スクリプトを使う場合
RUNTIME_DIR=/path/to/runtime PORT=3000 ./start.sh
```

または、単純に `index.html` をブラウザで開いても遊べます。

## 遊び方

1. ロビーで使用デッキを選ぶ（3種類 / 各 40枚 + EX 3枚）
2. 「ソロでデュエル」で CPU 戦、またはルームリストから相手のルームに参加
3. 手札をタップして「召喚」「セット」「発動」を選択
4. 自分のモンスターを選択して「攻撃」→ 相手モンスター、または相手 LP をタップ
5. 相手の LP を 0 にすれば勝利

### ルール

- 通常召喚は 1 ターンに 1 回
- レベル 5・6 のモンスターは生贄 1 体、レベル 7 以上は生贄 2 体
- EX モンスターは自分のモンスター 2 体を生贄に、空いている EX ゾーンへ EX 召喚
- 伏せた罠は相手の攻撃宣言時に自動発動
- 山札が 0 枚の状態でドローすると敗北
- 相手 LP が 0 になった時点で勝利

## ルームについて

起動時に `D24-XXXX` 形式の自分のルームが作成され、常に参加状態になります。
ルームリストは一定間隔で更新され、ホスト・モード・LP・人数・状態が変わります。
自分のルームには挑戦者が入室することがあり、そのままオンライン形式のデュエルを開始できます。

> このプロジェクトは静的サイトとして動作するため、ルームリストと対戦相手はブラウザ内のライブシミュレーションです。プロフィール、戦績、ルームコードは `localStorage` に保存されます。

## ファイル構成

```text
index.html          画面シェル（ロビー / ルーム / デュエル）
css/app.css         ビジュアル、24ゾーン、カード、アニメーション、レスポンシブ
js/cards.js         カード定義と3デッキ
```

## Objective
- Yu-Gi-Oh-style, text-only browser card game `DUEL 24` with online-style rooms, 24 zones, LP-to-0 victory, animated cards, no card images, and solo CPU play.
- New request: add `u成.VD11` and `ドラシェル玄武` to the game.

## Requirements
- Always create the player's own room at startup and keep the player joined to it.
- Provide an online room-list experience, a duel mode, solo mode, 24 zones, and LP 0 victory.
- Cards must always animate; no card images; Yu-Gi-Oh-style rules and presentation.
- Add `u成.VD11`: ATK 2011 / DEF 297; Special Summon only by releasing 1 monster you control; while attacking only, its ATK decreases by the released monster's DEF; cannot be destroyed by battle; damage its controller would take is redirected to the opponent.
- Add `ドラシェル玄武`: ATK 0 / DEF 2000.
- User asked for fastest completion.

## Decisions
- Static-site implementation; "online" rooms and opponents are locally simulated with live updates and `localStorage`.
- Field total is 24 zones: 5 monster + 5 spell/trap + 1 field per player, plus 2 shared Extra Monster Zones.
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/ES modules; no build step, images, external fonts, or assets.
- Deck size target remains 40 main + 3 Extra per deck.
- New cards need reasonable inferred metadata (attribute/race/level/rarity/glyph) because the user only supplied names, stats, and effect text.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game UI and engine implemented: lobby, mandatory auto-room, room list/detail, 3 decks, duel board, hand, summons, sets, attacks, traps, EX summons, logs, results, rematch, profile, records.
- Animation and synthesized sound systems implemented; cards use continuous CSS motion.
- Responsive desktop, portrait mobile, short-mobile, and landscape layouts verified.
- Browser checks passed for summon, attack, direct-attack victory, EX summon, room join/leave, rematch, persistence, and console error 0.
- 300 AI-vs-AI games passed before this card request: 0 errors, 0 stuck, average ~8.1 turns.
- README rewritten with game instructions and architecture.

### Active
- Integrate the two newly requested cards end-to-end.
- Decide which existing deck(s) receive the cards while preserving 40 main + 3 Extra counts.
- Add engine support for release-only Special Summon, attack-time ATK reduction, battle indestructibility, and damage redirection.
- Add UI/AI handling and verify the new cards in-browser and via simulation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add `u成.VD11` and `ドラシェル玄武` definitions to `js/cards.js` with balanced inferred metadata.
2. Add them to an appropriate deck (or decks) and confirm each deck remains exactly 40 main + 3 EX.
3. Extend `js/engine.js` with a release-1 Special Summon path and store the released monster's DEF on the summoned entry.
4. Apply the stored DEF as an attack-only ATK reduction inside battle calculation.
5. Implement battle indestructibility and redirect battle damage from `u成.VD11`'s controller to the opponent.
6. Expose the Special Summon action in `js/ui-duel.js` / `js/duel-render.js` and teach `js/ai.js` to use it.
7. Run syntax checks, deck-count checks, AI simulations, and browser tests for the new effects.

## Relevant Files
- `js/cards.js`: card definitions, effect metadata, decks, deck builders.
- `js/engine.js`: duel rules; needs release-only Special Summon and custom battle/damage hooks.
- `js/ai.js`: CPU action selection; needs awareness of the new Special Summon.
- `js/ui-duel.js`: duel input/actions; needs the Special Summon command and effect flow.
- `js/duel-render.js`: action tray and board rendering; needs the new action button/state.
- `js/ui-core.js`: shared card markup and detail rendering.
- `css/app.css`: card visuals, animations, board layouts, responsive rules.
- `js/rooms.js`: mandatory room, room-list simulation, profile storage.
- `js/fx.js`: card animations and synthesized SFX.
- `index.html`: app shell and screen structure.
- `README.md`: game rules, setup, architecture.

## Important Context
- All game files are still uncommitted; only `README.md` is tracked/modified, while `css/`, `js/`, `index.html`, and scripts are untracked.
- The app is served at `http://localhost:3000` via `RUNTIME_DIR=... PORT=3000 ./start.sh`.
- `Duel` effects currently use `resolveOps` with triggers `summon`, `activate`, and `attack`; there is no generic Special Summon/release hook yet.
- `attack()` currently resolves battle destruction and applies damage directly through `this.damage(...)`; the new redirection and indestructibility logic must be integrated there.
- `u成.VD11`'s ATK reduction should be temporary and apply only during its attack, based on the DEF of the monster released for its Special Summon.
- The user did not specify the new cards' level, attribute, race, rarity, or deck placement.

--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game.
